capabilities: Sequence tasks as drag-and-drop cards in a sidebar panel
Calculate per-task start times and estimated finish from durations
Edit durations and category labels inline
Mark tasks complete and clear completed ones
Write reorders, completions, and edits back to the markdown file
disambiguation: Not a task capture or project manager; it schedules tasks already written as markdown list items in an open note.
extras: Flagged as not manually reviewed by Obsidian staff; file-writeback sync settings are off by default, so the file is never touched unless enabled.
problem: Obsidian task lists are static text, so there is no view that sequences them with calculated start times and total duration.
summary: Sidebar panel that turns a markdown task list into a drag-and-drop sequenced schedule with compounding start times and category labels.
